observation: The earlier acceptance harness leaves a read/workspace_resource request without a target summary unanswered. With an explicitly opted-in least-privilege denial policy, its normal permission.reply reject can resolve the same live request without a Stop command or additional original Send.

localExecution.hostContract: First-wins deny forwards reject to the original native request and invocation.
localExecution.managedFixture: Actual Managed runtime forwards reject; the synthetic adapter continues that same invocation with an altered authenticated stage snapshot.
localExecution.scopeLimit: The adapter continuation is synthetic. Native model adaptation and real publication are not established.

guards: Exact live operation id, generation, version, pending host request id and conversation grant required.
Explicit independently supplied workflow policy required; the codes supply no path authority.
Only read/workspace_resource without any targetSummary or additional content fields is decided.
Reject must be a currently offered grant choice.
Existing exact permission rules retain precedence.
Other permissions remain undecided; once and always are never inferred.
Resolved, recovery-required, stale, foreign and duplicate requests cannot emit another decision.
